sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited algebraic data type plus EmptyCase makes a total function from an impossible argument to any result type.
sketches.resonance: Only what can never arrive is allowed to answer everything.

sketches.mechanism: A payable receive function immediately reverts, so every attempted Ether transfer is undone by the EVM transaction semantics.
sketches.resonance: The address can be reached, but nothing given to it can stay.

sketches.mechanism: wantarray observes the caller’s context, making the same subroutine return as a list or as a scalar depending on how it is received.
sketches.resonance: The self changes shape according to the hands waiting for it.
